player_ui.scope: 26 production UI scenes and five subviews across EN and ID at 320x568, 390x844 and 648x1152. The 320 px run included synthetic safe-area insets.

player_ui.limits: Guest and synthetic UI states in Godot headless. This scan covers geometry and visible copy at first paint and selected subviews. Live server paths, native rendering and Android touch remain separate.

crowd.workload: Same seeded input and fixed physics step in production stages 1-5 and 5-5. Each measured sample contains 480 frames.
rejected_experiments: unused area removal or monitoring changes
crowd.earlier_cosmetic_probe: The less aggressive pose experiment preserved measured hit traces but did not establish a repeatable frame-time improvement.

candidate_measurement.comparison: Restore exactly the five baseline combat source files in the same imported fixture. Alternate base and candidate order. Fixed 60 Hz simulation without render loop.
candidate_measurement.limit: Combat trace matched in all six pairs. This is Linux headless CPU time. One 110-enemy pair had no improvement, so this does not establish an Android FPS or dense-crowd fix.

candidate_changes: Short weapon picker caption and rank, wrapped stage guidance, compact saved-run confirmation.
Profile internals fit the scroll width with wrapped stats and a compact milestone grid.
Library selection reflects the visible filter and verified equipment ownership. Separate name, ownership and base stats.
Daily and Records title and cards adapt at compact widths. Reward totals are shown with the claim action.
Clearer Ascension rewards, standard Boss Hunt claim, paid Jade status and personal Trials risk.
performance_candidate: Sleep the extra passive sprite pose on ordinary enemies when the crowd reaches 80 and wake it below 72, on hit or during casts. Authored sprite animation, hit detection and enemy collision paths continue.
qa_output_policy: Keep imports, fixtures, captures, saves and logs outside the project.
next: For owner validation, pull the published work branch and confirm its receipt. Run the final phone cycle and verify the dense scenes, fresh boot, and touch layouts before Play closed testing.
Keep the AdMob hold and preserve the existing production exporter and nine gates.

final_notes: The broad audit opens 26 production scenes at three sizes in both locales, with focused assertion coverage on changed controls. All remaining failures from the broad sweep were Ascension-only and are covered by the final focused pass.
Native evidence uses Godot X11 with simulated GUI input. Owner Windows installation and Android performance are separate.
No owner QA files were written. Imports, saves, logs and renders used disposable QA storage.
